notes.title: Castle Bomber RED is Now LIVE!
notes.content:
The wait is over. Castle Bomber RED is officially out!

In this explosive game, you’ve got three lives to destroy as many castle cores as possible using strategic cannon placement and a whole lot of projectile firepower. 

Jump in now and start bombing:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3389220/Castle_Bomber_RED/

Thanks for the support, and good luck bringing the castles down. 💥
